definitions.name: Elemental Substance
definitions.description: Pure single-element substance

definitions.name: Inorganic Compound
definitions.description: Chemical compound not classified as organic

definitions.name: Organic Compound
definitions.description: Carbon-containing compound (excluding simple oxides/carbonates)

definitions.name: Organometallic Compound
definitions.description: Compound containing direct metal-carbon bond

definitions.name: Coordination Compound
definitions.description: Complex compound with central metal atom and ligands

definitions.name: Unknown Domain
definitions.description: Unclassified substance domain

definitions.name: Monoatomic or Elemental
definitions.description: Composed of atoms of a single element type

definitions.name: Binary Composition
definitions.description: Composed of exactly two distinct element types

definitions.name: Ternary Composition
definitions.description: Composed of exactly three distinct element types

definitions.name: Quaternary or Higher Composition
definitions.description: Composed of four or more distinct element types

definitions.name: Hydrate
definitions.description: Compound containing bound water of crystallization

definitions.name: Charged Species
definitions.description: Ion or charged chemical species

definitions.name: Neutral Species
definitions.description: Electrically neutral molecule or formula unit

definitions.name: Oxide
definitions.description: Binary or complex oxygen-containing inorganic compound

definitions.name: Peroxide
definitions.description: Compound containing an oxygen-oxygen single bond (O2 2-)

definitions.name: Hydride
definitions.description: Compound of hydrogen with another element

definitions.name: Hydroxide
definitions.description: Compound containing the hydroxide anion (OH-)

definitions.name: Acid
definitions.description: Proton donor (Brønsted-Lowry acid)

definitions.name: Base
definitions.description: Proton acceptor or hydroxide donor

definitions.name: Salt
definitions.description: Ionic compound composed of cations and anions

definitions.name: Other Inorganic
definitions.description: Inorganic compound not fitting primary classes

definitions.name: Binary Acid
definitions.description: Acid composed of hydrogen and one nonmetal element

definitions.name: Oxyacid
definitions.description: Acid containing hydrogen, oxygen, and another element

definitions.name: Other Acid
definitions.description: Acid subtype not falling under binary acid or oxyacid

definitions.name: Normal Salt
definitions.description: Salt formed by complete neutralization of an acid by a base

definitions.name: Acid Salt
definitions.description: Salt containing replaceable hydrogen atoms from a polyprotic acid

definitions.name: Basic Salt
definitions.description: Salt containing hydroxide ions or basic anions

definitions.name: Double Salt
definitions.description: Salt containing more than one cation or anion

definitions.name: Hydrated Salt
definitions.description: Salt incorporating water molecules into its crystal lattice

definitions.name: Other Salt
definitions.description: Salt subtype not falling under primary categories

definitions.name: Hydrocarbon
definitions.description: Organic compound composed entirely of hydrogen and carbon

definitions.name: Alcohol
definitions.description: Organic compound containing a hydroxyl group (-OH) bound to saturated carbon

definitions.name: Ether
definitions.description: Organic compound containing an ether group (R-O-R)

definitions.name: Aldehyde
definitions.description: Organic compound containing a carbonyl group (-CHO)

definitions.name: Ketone
definitions.description: Organic compound containing a carbonyl group (R-CO-R)

definitions.name: Carboxylic Acid
definitions.description: Organic compound containing a carboxyl group (-COOH)

definitions.name: Ester
definitions.description: Organic compound derived from an acid where OH is replaced by O-alkyl

definitions.name: Amine
definitions.description: Organic compound derived from ammonia by replacing hydrogen with alkyl/aryl groups

definitions.name: Amide
definitions.description: Organic compound containing a carbonyl group bound to nitrogen

definitions.name: Carbohydrate
definitions.description: Organic compound composed of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen (polyhydroxy aldehydes/ketones)

definitions.name: Other Organic
definitions.description: Organic compound not fitting primary functional classes
